title: JRFK backup reports empty USB SD reader as mounted, and reports SD card missing when inserted
resolution: Fixed in rfk_backup.sh: 1) Checked media size via lsblk to verify capacity > 0, correctly identifying empty card readers as unpopulated. 2) Replaced substring check on /proc/mounts with explicit detection of root and boot block devices using findmnt, preventing automounted desktop partitions from disqualifying valid USB SD targets. 3) Added unmount_target_partitions() to safely detach any desktop automounted target partitions before piclone or dd executes.
comments: Root Cause Analysis: 1) Empty USB SD reader creates /dev/sda block device with 0 bytes capacity, but script only checks [ -b /dev/sda ], erroneously reporting target_found=true with 0 bytes. 2) When an SD card is inserted, desktop udisks2/pcmanfm automounts partitions (/dev/sda1, /dev/sda2) to /media/pi/. The script check "! grep -qs $dev /proc/mounts" substring-matches the mounted partitions, causing find_target_dev() to discard the valid SD card and report target missing. Fix required: Check that media capacity > 0 (size > 0), and check that /dev/sda is not the active rootfs/boot device without rejecting automounted target partitions.

Added full telemetry decoder in onTelemetryReceived for header 0x89 with bytes[1] == 7, handling wear-off status (bytes[3] == 4), busy status, and real HRV/stress scoring (bytes[4]). Retained legacy 0x81 dual compatibility.
comments: Reported by user: HRV not working. Model 5010 firmware uses modern 0x89 sub-command 0x07 for autonomic HRV detection rather than legacy fatigue 0x81.

title: SOMNO-03 Circadian Sleep Architecture displaying empty values after query
resolution: Implemented full multi-packet sleep stream reassembly per Veepoo SDK vp_cl.java and vp_b.java. Corrected indexing from single-packet bytes[43] to reassembled 96-byte payload (fullBuf[9]=deep, fullBuf[10]=light, fullBuf[43]=allSleep, fullBuf[55]=wake). Added automatic Day 0 -> Day 1 query fallback when Day 0 returns all zeros so previous night sleep architecture is reliably retrieved.
comments: Reported by user: SOMNO-03 empty this is very important. Sleep telemetry arrives across 6 consecutive 20-byte BLE packets with 16 bytes payload each; previous code checked bytes.length > 43 on a single 20-byte packet, preventing data extraction.

title: Watch entering "Measuring keep still" mode instead of new face when hitting Apply

Added 200ms yield to allow watch PPG diodes to power down before transmitting 20-byte 0xC7 0x01 slot change.
comments: Reported by user: when we hit watch face apply watch goes into measurement not new face. Active continuous heart rate stream (0xD0) kept watch hardware locked in optical acquisition state, causing the physical screen to display Measuring keep still rather than switching styles.
